senses.gloss:
m. (-लः)
The sound of a small oblong drum.
E.
गुद to play, अलच् affix, and नुम् inserted.

m. (-लः)
1 A kind of bird, (a sort of pheasant?)
2 The bartavelle: see चकोर.
E.
गुन्द्रा a kind of grass, and ल what takes or eats, र rejected; also read गुन्द्राल.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A kind of grass, (Saccharum sara.)
f. (-न्द्रा)
1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis; also C. rotundus.)
2 A plant bearing a fragrant seed; also प्रियङ्गु.
E.
गुद to play, affix रक्, and नुम् inserted.

m. (-लः)
A sort of bird: see गुन्दाल.

m. (-नः-ना-नं)
Voided, (as ordure.)
E.
गू to stool, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
